name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: LinkedIn URL of the person you want to send a message to. Optional if Thread ID is provided.

name: threadId
label: Thread ID
help: Identifier of an existing conversation thread to reply into, as returned by Poll Inbox. Provide this instead of Person URL to reply directly into a known thread.

name: messageText
label: Message Text
help: Message text, must be up to 1900 characters
